name: Why is mold a concern after a ceiling leak, and how is it handled?

mainEntity.name: Why is mold a concern after a ceiling leak, and how is it handled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold is a major concern because it can start growing within 24-48 hours of water exposure and can cause health issues and further property damage. Professionals address mold by isolating the affected area, using specialized filtration equipment to prevent spore spread, safely removing mold-contaminated materials, and thoroughly cleaning and sanitizing surfaces. Proper drying is crucial to prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can grow quickly after a leak, causing health and property damage. Professionals isolate, remove, and clean contaminated areas.
